queries.search_text: site:single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu late payments report 2025 businesses European Commission
queries.proposition: The European Commission reports that more than half of companies experienced late-payment difficulties in 2024, average B2B and government-to-business payment periods exceeded 60 days, and collection creates administrative burden; public-sector exposure is especially relevant to construction and healthcare.
queries.contradiction: The source says payment performance varies widely and does not establish that any named Polish niche will buy a recovery product, that software alone changes payer behaviour, or that a particular invoice is collectible.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Interview ten Polish suppliers with invoices overdue by at least one contract cycle and request anonymized timelines, rejection reasons, and a signed contingent-fee pilot from one buyer of the service.

queries.search_text: site:enisa.europa.eu 2025 NIS2 supply chain cybersecurity procurement report SMEs
queries.proposition: ENISA reports on how EU cybersecurity policy affects organisational investment, resources, and operations using responses from 1,080 professionals in high-criticality NIS sectors, making vendor and control-evidence work a current operational issue.
queries.contradiction: The sample is 83% large enterprises and only 17% SMEs; it does not prove Polish demand, procurement authority, acceptance of standardized evidence, or budgets for any proposed intermediary.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Ask eight regulated buyers and eight small suppliers to score one mock evidence dossier against a live questionnaire, then seek one paid dossier-preparation engagement contingent on buyer acceptance.

concepts.title: Construction Change-Order Acceptance Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Turn subcontractors' scattered proof of extra work into contract-mapped acceptance packets and charge only when an invoice moves from disputed to approved.
concepts.customer: Polish electrical, HVAC, and renewable-installation subcontractors serving larger general contractors
concepts.loss_event: A completed variation remains unpaid because instructions, site records, photos, and contractual notice requirements do not line up.
concepts.payer: The subcontractor whose receivable is blocked
concepts.beneficiary: The subcontractor and its employees or suppliers who depend on cash flow
concepts.authority_holder: The general contractor's project manager or contract administrator who can accept the variation
concepts.distributor: Construction accountants, quantity surveyors, and regional trade associations
concepts.risk_bearer: The subcontractor, which has already funded labour and materials
concepts.transaction_owner: The subcontractor's owner or finance lead
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed intake fee plus a disclosed success fee when the counterparty records the invoice as approved for payment
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer accountants a no-cost receivables triage checklist and referral fee for eligible disputed change orders.
concepts.compounding_asset: A clause-to-evidence library and anonymized resolution patterns by contractor, project type, and rejection reason
hypotheses: A meaningful share of delayed change-order invoices are blocked by curable evidence defects rather than genuine insolvency.
Subcontractors will share contracts and site evidence under strict confidentiality.
Counterparties will recognize a well-structured packet without requiring legal representation.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No fabricated site record, backdated notice, unauthorized legal practice, or misleading claim that payment is guaranteed.

concepts.title: Public-Healthcare Invoice Exception Resolver
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Diagnose administrative rejection loops for small clinical suppliers and collect a fee for each invoice that the public buyer validates for payment.
concepts.customer: Independent laboratories, rehabilitation providers, and medical consumables suppliers billing public hospitals or public purchasers
concepts.loss_event: A valid delivery or service is trapped in an invoice exception queue because purchase-order, delivery, coding, or acceptance data disagree.
concepts.payer: The clinical supplier with the delayed invoice
concepts.beneficiary: The supplier, while the hospital benefits from a cleaner payable record
concepts.authority_holder: The hospital's procurement, clinical acceptance, and accounts-payable staff
concepts.distributor: Medical-sector bookkeeping firms and procurement consultants
concepts.risk_bearer: The supplier financing wages, inventory, or consumables during the delay
concepts.transaction_owner: The supplier's billing or finance manager
concepts.first_paid_event: A per-invoice fee when the hospital confirms that the exception is cleared and the invoice is scheduled
concepts.acquisition_route: Run a confidential exception audit on one aged receivable supplied by a specialist medical bookkeeper.
concepts.compounding_asset: A privacy-minimized taxonomy of rejection causes, required documents, and resolution paths by purchasing system
hypotheses: Enough delayed healthcare invoices have resolvable administrative causes to support outcome-linked pricing.
Suppliers can lawfully provide the necessary non-patient documentation.
Hospital staff will confirm status changes through existing official channels.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No patient-data access, impersonation, improper influence, invoice alteration, or promise to bypass public procurement controls.

concepts.title: Freight Accessorial Proof-to-Cash
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Reconstruct detention, demurrage, and failed-delivery claims from telematics and documents, taking a share only of fees actually recovered.
concepts.customer: Small road carriers and freight forwarders operating across Poland and neighboring EU markets
concepts.loss_event: A carrier absorbs waiting time or redelivery cost because evidence is fragmented or a claim deadline is missed.
concepts.payer: The carrier or forwarder pursuing the accessorial charge
concepts.beneficiary: The carrier and driver whose capacity was consumed
concepts.authority_holder: The shipper, consignee, broker, or platform claims team that approves the fee
concepts.distributor: Fleet telematics resellers, transport accountants, and factoring brokers
concepts.risk_bearer: The carrier, including fuel, driver time, and lost next-load revenue
concepts.transaction_owner: The carrier's dispatcher or accounts-receivable lead
concepts.first_paid_event: A percentage of a documented accessorial charge after cash reaches the carrier
concepts.acquisition_route: Use a telematics-partner referral to audit one month of closed loads for unbilled waiting events.
concepts.compounding_asset: A lane-, counterparty-, and contract-specific model of claim acceptance, evidence sufficiency, and deadline risk
hypotheses: Telematics and delivery records can identify economically material unclaimed events.
Carrier contracts permit the claimed fees and evidence submission.
Recovered value exceeds verification and dispute-handling cost.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No invented timestamps, GPS manipulation, duplicate claims, or submission of charges absent a contractual basis.

concepts.title: Commercial Solar Milestone Certifier
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Package commissioning evidence against commercial rooftop acceptance clauses so installers can unlock milestone invoices before minor punch-list work obscures completed value.
concepts.customer: Small and mid-sized photovoltaic and storage installers delivering projects to commercial property owners
concepts.loss_event: A large installation milestone is withheld because technical completion, punch-list items, and documentary acceptance are conflated.
concepts.payer: The installer awaiting the milestone payment
concepts.beneficiary: The installer and its equipment or labour suppliers
concepts.authority_holder: The property owner's engineer, project manager, or authorized acceptance representative
concepts.distributor: Equipment wholesalers, renewable-installation associations, and project insurers
concepts.risk_bearer: The installer carrying equipment and labour costs
concepts.transaction_owner: The installer's project director or finance lead
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed per-project evidence-pack fee after the authorized representative accepts the relevant milestone
concepts.acquisition_route: Pilot through the founder's family installation network on one completed commercial project with an aging milestone invoice.
concepts.compounding_asset: A verified mapping among contract clauses, commissioning artifacts, defect categories, and acceptance outcomes
hypotheses: Document ambiguity rather than substantive non-performance blocks a repeatable subset of milestone payments.
Owners will evaluate third-party-organized evidence without treating it as unauthorized certification.
A narrow initial service can be delivered within part-time founder capacity.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No claim to perform legally reserved inspection, concealment of defects, forged commissioning data, or conflicted certification.

concepts.title: Supplier Payment-Latency Cooperative
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Let SME suppliers contribute privacy-safe invoice outcomes and subscribe to counterparty-specific payment-friction signals before accepting long terms.
concepts.customer: Polish B2B suppliers repeatedly extending unsecured trade credit to larger customers
concepts.loss_event: A supplier accepts a low-margin order without knowing that the buyer routinely stretches terms or creates invoice exceptions.
concepts.payer: The supplier deciding whether and how to quote credit terms
concepts.beneficiary: Participating suppliers and their financing partners
concepts.authority_holder: Each supplier's credit controller, who sets terms, and the data contributors, who authorize permitted use
concepts.distributor: Accounting platforms, factoring brokers, and trade-credit insurers
concepts.transaction_owner: The supplier's owner or credit manager
concepts.first_paid_event: A subscription purchased before the supplier approves a new credit limit or renewal
concepts.acquisition_route: Recruit one accounting network to offer founding members a report generated from their own ledger history plus pooled aggregates.
concepts.compounding_asset: A consented, outcome-based payment graph with sector, term, dispute, and invoice-quality context
hypotheses: Suppliers will contribute suitably minimized payment outcomes in exchange for useful pooled intelligence.
Lawful aggregation can avoid disclosing protected or misleading company-level claims.
Payment behavior is sufficiently persistent to improve credit-term decisions.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No covert scraping of private invoices, publication of unverified accusations, collusive exclusion, or sale of identifiable contributor data.

concepts.title: Hospital Vendor Security Evidence Passport
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Maintain a reusable, buyer-verifiable security dossier for small health-software and device vendors and charge when it clears a hospital procurement gate.
concepts.customer: Small European health-software, connected-device, and clinical-service vendors selling to hospitals
concepts.loss_event: A sale stalls while the vendor repeatedly answers overlapping security questionnaires and hunts for control evidence.
concepts.payer: The vendor whose contract is delayed
concepts.beneficiary: The vendor and the hospital procurement and security teams
concepts.authority_holder: The hospital CISO, data protection, clinical engineering, and procurement approvers
concepts.distributor: Health-tech accelerators, medical-device consultants, and hospital procurement advisers
concepts.risk_bearer: The hospital bears third-party cyber exposure while the vendor bears delayed revenue and remediation cost
concepts.transaction_owner: The vendor's founder, compliance lead, or enterprise-sales lead
concepts.first_paid_event: A dossier fee due when a named hospital marks the security review complete or identifies only bounded remediation items
concepts.acquisition_route: Convert one live hospital questionnaire for a referred vendor into a normalized evidence map and reusable renewal file.
concepts.compounding_asset: A control-to-question mapping and acceptance-history corpus segmented by hospital type and vendor architecture
hypotheses: Hospitals repeat enough questions for a maintained evidence passport to shorten review.
Hospital approvers will verify rather than reject standardized vendor evidence.
Vendors will pay against a procurement milestone instead of buying generic compliance advice.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No false certification, concealed vulnerability, fabricated control evidence, patient-data collection, or guarantee of regulatory compliance.

concepts.title: Utility Tender Cyber-Clause Translator
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Convert municipal utility cyber clauses into a scoped supplier evidence plan and sell a fixed-price submission pack for each live tender.
concepts.customer: Small OT maintenance, metering, engineering, and software suppliers bidding to municipal utilities
concepts.loss_event: A qualified supplier loses or abandons a tender because cyber clauses are ambiguous, duplicative, or discovered too late.
concepts.payer: The supplier bidding for the utility contract
concepts.beneficiary: The supplier and the utility seeking comparable, reviewable assurances
concepts.authority_holder: The utility's procurement officer and security or OT owner
concepts.distributor: Tender writers, municipal engineering consultancies, and industrial insurance brokers
concepts.risk_bearer: The utility bears supply-chain operational risk; the supplier bears bid cost and lost-contract risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The supplier's bid manager or managing director
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed fee after delivery of a compliant evidence pack for a specific tender, with a smaller pre-bid eligibility screen
concepts.acquisition_route: Monitor public tender notices and offer a rapid, paid clause-gap screen through established tender consultants.
concepts.compounding_asset: A versioned library linking procurement clauses to evidence types, supplier controls, clarifications, and accepted submissions
hypotheses: Cyber requirements cause measurable bid friction for otherwise capable small utility suppliers.
Public buyers permit clarification and structured evidence without favoring a bidder.
Repeated clause patterns make each subsequent pack cheaper to prepare.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No bid coordination, inside information, misrepresentation of controls, procurement circumvention, or unauthorized legal certification.

concepts.title: Renewable Fleet Access Attestation
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Continuously reconcile who can access commercial solar and storage monitoring portals, producing owner-approved attestations that O&M firms buy per managed fleet.
concepts.customer: Regional solar and storage O&M providers managing assets for multiple commercial owners
concepts.loss_event: Former staff, installers, vendors, or shared accounts retain portal access, leaving owners exposed while no party owns the cleanup record.
concepts.payer: The O&M provider contractually responsible for reliable asset operations
concepts.beneficiary: Commercial asset owners, O&M providers, and their insurers
concepts.authority_holder: The asset owner or designated security administrator who approves access changes
concepts.distributor: Inverter distributors, renewable insurers, and the family installation firm's commercial network
concepts.risk_bearer: The asset owner bears production and incident loss; the O&M provider bears contractual and reputational loss
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid baseline access review followed by a recurring fee when the owner signs the quarterly attestation
concepts.acquisition_route: Run a permission inventory for one multi-site owner introduced by an installer or inverter distributor.
concepts.compounding_asset: A vendor-agnostic connector library and anonymized graph of access drift, remediation time, and recurring failure modes
hypotheses: Multi-site renewable portfolios have material unmanaged portal-access drift.
Owners can authorize read-only inventory and explicit remediation workflows.
O&M contracts can absorb a recurring attestation line item.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No credential sharing, unauthorized login, silent account changes, vulnerability exploitation, or claim that an access review proves full security.

concepts.title: MSP Insurance Evidence Preflight
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Preflight a small managed-service provider's controls against an insurer's live renewal questions and charge when the submission is accepted as complete.
concepts.customer: Small managed-service providers and managed-security providers seeking cyber cover or serving insured clients
concepts.loss_event: Coverage is delayed, narrowed, or priced without credit because the MSP and broker cannot produce consistent patching, testing, backup, and supplier-control evidence.
concepts.payer: The MSP applying for or renewing coverage
concepts.beneficiary: The MSP, its clients, the broker, and the underwriter receiving more reviewable evidence
concepts.authority_holder: The insurer's underwriter, who alone determines sufficiency, price, and coverage
concepts.distributor: Cyber-insurance brokers, IT-sector accountants, and MSP associations
concepts.risk_bearer: The insurer bears covered loss; the MSP bears exclusions, premium, incident, and client-loss exposure
concepts.transaction_owner: The MSP owner or risk lead together with the broker
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed preflight fee when the underwriter accepts the application as complete, separate from any coverage decision
concepts.acquisition_route: Give a broker a white-label completeness check for one difficult renewal and request referral rights if review time falls.
concepts.compounding_asset: A permissioned map of insurer questions, accepted evidence forms, control gaps, and renewal changes over time
hypotheses: Evidence quality and consistency create avoidable underwriting delay for small MSPs.
Brokers will distribute a neutral readiness service that does not sell or bind insurance.
Underwriters will provide a clear completeness signal that can trigger the fee.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No acting as an unlicensed broker, hiding incidents, falsifying controls, influencing underwriting improperly, or guaranteeing coverage or premium reduction.
